requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.5 Figure 11 / Table 10 (GBB message for triggered requests: request_type=0x0E/0x8E, trigger_source_ep, trigger_signal_nr, trigger_threshold, trigger_exec_delay, trigger_repetitions), TC18.txt L1685-1755

requirements.title: decode_triggered_request() maps ACF decode failures to RequestCodecError
requirements.text: decode_triggered_request() shall return RequestCodecError::ShortFrame or RequestCodecError::BadMsgType when the ACF_GBB frame is short/inconsistent or not ACF_GBB (c-RCP REQ-TRIG-005).
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2 ("conditional requests are sent using ACF_GBB having mtv = 0 (time stamp not valid) and using the bytes of the message_timestamp field to convey the execution condition"), TC18.txt L1255-1258; general ACF_GBB frame-validation basis

requirements.title: encode_chained_member() rejects an oversized payload
requirements.text: encode_chained_member() shall return Err(RcpError::InvalidSize) when the payload does not fit the ACF 9-bit quadlet range (c-RCP REQ-CHAIN-003).
requirements.tc18: §11.2.2.6 Figure 12 / field table (GBB for chained requests: request_type=0x01, reserved octets, chain_exec_delay, cs), TC18.txt L1773-1847; general ACF_GBB frame-validation basis

requirements.title: encode_clear_all() encodes a zero-payload clear-all request
requirements.text: encode_clear_all() shall produce a 16-octet ACF_GBB frame with mtv = 0, the opcode byte RequestKind::ClearAll (0x05) and the remaining 7 repurposed sub-field octets zero (c-RCP REQ-CANCEL-002).
requirements.tc18: §11.2.3.1 Figure 14 + Table 13 (clear-all, request_type 0x05), TC18.txt L1983-2050

requirements.title: decode_clear_all() maps decode failures and rejects a non-clear-all opcode
requirements.text: decode_clear_all() shall return RequestCodecError::ShortFrame/BadMsgType/NotRepurposed for a short, non-ACF_GBB or mtv-set frame and RequestCodecError::UnknownType when the opcode byte is not 0x05, and shall otherwise return the decoded byte_bus_id and transaction_num (c-RCP REQ-CANCEL-003/004).
requirements.tc18: §11.2.3.1 Figure 14 / Table 13 (Usage of GBB message to cancel all requests, request_type=0x05), TC18.txt L1983-2050; general ACF_GBB frame-validation basis and §11.2.2 ("conditional requests are sent using ACF_GBB having mtv = 0 (time stamp not valid) and using the bytes of the message_timestamp field to convey the execution condition"), TC18.txt L1255-1258

requirements.title: each sequencer is owned by one request stream, and only that stream may access it
requirements.text: SequencerBank shall carry a per-sequencer owner (TC18 §12.7.10 Table 28 Request_stream_index), SEQUENCER_OWNER_UNCLAIMED (0) by default; owner()/set_owner() read/write it with Err(RcpError::SequencerNotKnown) for an out-of-bounds index; access_permitted() is true iff the index is valid and the owner is claimed and equals the requester (fail-closed for an unclaimed sequencer); check_compound_admission() applies that check to a compound/compound-wait request's sequencer_index at admission, skipped when the bank has no sequencers (c-RCP src/request_sequencer.c:94-140, src/mock.c:1649-1676).
requirements.tc18: §12.7.10 Table 28, TC18.txt L3460-L3493 (2-octet stride: relative 0x0000 Seq_state, 0x0001 Request_stream_index)

requirements.title: SequencerAccess distinguishes SEQUENCER_NOT_KNOWN (unknown index) from UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS (real sequencer, wrong owner)
requirements.text: SequencerBank::access_check() shall return SequencerAccess::Unknown when the index does not address a configured sequencer (checked before ownership), SequencerAccess::Denied when the sequencer is unclaimed or owned by another stream, and SequencerAccess::Permitted otherwise; SequencerAccess::wire_error() shall map Unknown to RcpError::SequencerNotKnown (wire code 2), Denied to RcpError::UnauthorizedAccess (wire code 3) and Permitted to None (c-RCP rcp_sequencer_access_check()/rcp_sequencer_wire_error()).
requirements.tc18: §12.7.10 Table 28 (own-access-control rule, "Request_stream_index... allowed to access this sequencer"), TC18.txt L3460-3493; §12.9.6 Table 30 (SEQUENCER_NOT_KNOWN=2, UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS=3), TC18.txt L3812-3844

requirements.title: per-stream sequence-number enforcement (rx_enforce_seq)
requirements.text: SequenceTracker::evaluate(rx_enforce_seq, rx_seq_safestate_enable, seq) shall, on a stream's first frame, accept with no discontinuity; afterwards, with fwd = (seq - prev_seq) mod 256, accept iff !rx_enforce_seq or 1 <= fwd <= 127 (RFC 1982 window, so 255 -> 0 is an advance), report discontinuity iff fwd != 1, and advance prev_seq only on accept. It is evaluated once per received frame over the AVTPDU's 8-bit sequence_num (c-RCP rcp_e2e_seq_evaluate(), src/e2e.c:516; frame_seq_gate_admits(), src/mock.c:3038).

requirements.title: sequence-error safe-state escalation (rx_seq_safestate_enable)
requirements.text: SequenceTracker::evaluate() shall set enter_safe_state = discontinuity && rx_seq_safestate_enable, i.e. on any discontinuity including an accepted gap and regardless of rx_enforce_seq. c-RCP parity (src/e2e.c:543-544): TC18 RC5 §12.7.7 Table 24 describes safe state on out-of-order rejection only; this crate copies c-RCP for interop.

requirements.title: E2eError gives every error a distinct message and c-RCP's numeric code
requirements.text: e2e::E2eError::strerror shall return a distinct message for every variant, matching c-RCP rcp_e2e_strerror's text, Display shall print that message, and E2eError::code shall return c-RCP's rcp_e2e_errc_t value (ShortFrame = 1, CrcMismatch = 2) (port of c-RCP src/e2e.c:11-25)

requirements.title: compute_crc covers avtp_subtype, header_octet1, tu, stream_id, avtp_timestamp, and the ACF region, in that order
requirements.text: e2e::compute_crc shall return the same value as crc32_tc18 over the concatenation of avtp_subtype (1 byte), header_octet1 (1 byte), a tu byte (1 byte, LSB = tu), stream_id (8 bytes, big-endian), avtp_timestamp (4 bytes, big-endian), and acf_frame (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_compute_crc, src/e2e.c:124-150), and shall match c-RCP's output byte-for-byte on shared golden vectors
requirements.tc18: §13.6 ("In Safe command mode a CRC32 is calculated per ACF type across specific fields of an AVTPDU header, ACF header, and the entire payload (except padding)."; covered header fields per Figure 20/21), OA_TC18_specification_v_0.5.1_RC_5 p.87-89

requirements.title: length_with_crc applies the length-accounting pre-adjustment
requirements.text: e2e::length_with_crc shall return payload_len + CRC_TRAILER_LEN, saturating at usize::MAX rather than wrapping (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_length_with_crc)
requirements.tc18: §13.6 ("When calculating the CRC, it needs to be considered that adding the CRC to the byte_msg_payload increases the acf_msg_length by 1."), OA_TC18_specification_v_0.5.1_RC_5 p.88

requirements.title: wrap places the CRC32 from compute_crc after the real payload, before the pad
requirements.text: e2e::wrap shall return a copy of the encoded ACF frame with acf_msg_length incremented by one quadlet and the big-endian compute_crc value over the adjusted header-and-real-payload prefix placed immediately after the real payload, followed by the frame's own pad octets (located via the pad field, octet 2 bits 7:6), giving [header][real payload][CRC32][pad] byte-for-byte as c-RCP rcp_e2e_wrap (src/e2e.c:200-272)
requirements.tc18: §13.6 Figure 20/Figure 21 (ACF_ABB under TSCF / ACF_GBB under NTSCF: payload, CRC32, then padding), OA_TC18_specification_v_0.5.1_RC_5 p.88-89

requirements.title: wrap fails safe on invalid input
requirements.text: e2e::wrap shall return Err(RcpError::InvalidSize) for a frame whose length is not a whole number of quadlets or whose acf_msg_length is already 0x1FF, and Err(RcpError::ShortFrame) when the real prefix is shorter than the 2-octet length field (including an empty frame), never panicking (c-RCP rcp_e2e_wrap returns an empty buffer in the same cases)

requirements.title: unwrap rejects a frame too short for the CRC32 trailer and claimed pad
requirements.text: e2e::unwrap shall return Err(E2eError::ShortFrame) whenever the frame is shorter than CRC_TRAILER_LEN or than CRC_TRAILER_LEN plus the pad count its pad field claims, never panicking for any input (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_unwrap)

requirements.title: unwrap reports a CRC mismatch
requirements.text: e2e::unwrap shall return Err(E2eError::CrcMismatch { acf_frame }) whenever the 4 octets after the real payload do not equal compute_crc over the frame's real prefix; acf_frame is the unverified body for diagnostics and the caller shall skip executing the request (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_unwrap, src/e2e.c:277-339)
requirements.tc18: §13.6 ("If a request is received by an endpoint that is in 'Safe command mode' and the CRC does not match, the request is not executed, and an error response is generated"), OA_TC18_specification_v_0.5.1_RC_5 p.87

requirements.title: unwrap round-trips a frame produced by wrap
requirements.text: For a frame produced by e2e::wrap from an encoded ACF frame, e2e::unwrap called with the same avtp_subtype, header_octet1, tu, stream_id and avtp_timestamp shall return Ok with exactly the original frame (trailer removed, acf_msg_length restored), including frames produced by c-RCP rcp_e2e_wrap_framed
requirements.tc18: §13.6 ("The CRC calculation for requests and responses follows the identical scheme."), TC18.txt L4276

requirements.title: fragment_carries_crc implements the fragmentation/CRC interaction rule
requirements.text: e2e::fragment_carries_crc shall return is_last_fragment unmodified, modeling that only a multi-segment message's final fragment carries a CRC (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_fragment_carries_crc)
requirements.tc18: §13.6 ("Fragmentation, if applied to a message, happens after CRC calculation. So, the CRC is only calculated once and will be transmitted in the last segment."), TC18.txt L4274-4275

requirements.title: wrap_framed/unwrap_framed derive the subtype and force NTSCF tu/avtp_timestamp to zero
requirements.text: e2e::wrap_framed and e2e::unwrap_framed shall use avtp_subtype 0x82 when is_ntscf_framed and 0x05 otherwise, and under NTSCF shall feed tu = false and avtp_timestamp = 0 whatever the caller passed, otherwise passing tu and avtp_timestamp through; header_octet1 is always passed through (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_wrap_framed/_unwrap_framed, src/e2e.c:344-368). c-RCP parity: the zero stand-ins are fed to the CRC although TC18 RC5 Figure 21 has no avtp_timestamp/tu field
requirements.tc18: §13.6 Figure 21, OA_TC18_specification_v_0.5.1_RC_5 p.89; c-RCP parity divergence

requirements.title: AVTPDU data length grows by 4 octets for every E2E-protected ACF message
requirements.text: e2e::data_length_for_protected_members shall return protected_member_count * CRC_TRAILER_LEN, saturating at usize::MAX (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_data_length_for_protected_members)

requirements.title: compute_fragmented_crc covers the header prefix, the first fragment's ACF header and every segment's payload
requirements.text: e2e::compute_fragmented_crc shall return crc32_tc18 over avtp_subtype, header_octet1, a tu byte, stream_id, avtp_timestamp, first_fragment_header and reassembled_payload concatenated (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_compute_fragmented_crc, src/e2e.c:379-406), matching c-RCP on a shared golden fragment-train vector. c-RCP parity: the first fragment's header is fed as sent (no +1 quadlet, its own length/pad/ms/segment_num) whereas TC18-13.6-007 reads as a whole-message header
requirements.tc18: §13.6 ("Fragmentation, if applied to a message, happens after CRC calculation. So, the CRC is only calculated once and will be transmitted in the last segment."), TC18.txt L4274-4275

requirements.title: E2eError::wire_error maps a CRC mismatch to POCI_FAILURE
requirements.text: e2e::E2eError::wire_error shall return Some(RcpError::PociFailure) (wire code 12) for CrcMismatch and None for ShortFrame, which has no wire-error-code counterpart (port of c-RCP rcp_e2e_wire_error, src/e2e.c:28-42)
requirements.tc18: §12.9.6 Table 30 ("POCI_FAILURE 12 - CRC of request does not match"), TC18.txt L3830

requirements.title: wrap_for_header/unwrap_for_header read every CRC input from a decoded AVTPDU header
requirements.text: e2e::wrap_for_header(header, frame) and e2e::unwrap_for_header(header, frame) shall equal wrap_framed/unwrap_framed called with header's stream_id, its variant (NTSCF or TSCF), HeaderVariant::octet1, HeaderVariant::tu and, for TSCF, its avtp_timestamp, reproducing c-RCP's golden vectors for NTSCF+ACF_ABB and TSCF+ACF_GBB
